claude.sample_unit: test cases (imaging reports of stroke-related hospitalizations)

links.outcome: Whether LLM-derived confidence/uncertainty separates accurate from inaccurate classifications
links.effect: Low-uncertainty cases outperformed high-uncertainty cases in weighted F1: 0.94 vs 0.57 in stage 1 and 0.82 vs 0.58 in stage 2.
links.quote: Low-uncertainty cases consistently outperformed high-uncertainty cases in both stages (weighted F1-scores: 0.94 vs 0.57 in stage 1 and 0.82 vs 0.58 in stage 2).

links.outcome: Deferral of uncertain cases to human review while maintaining accuracy and reducing review burden
links.effect: Manual review burden reduced by 75%; overall F1 rose from 0.840 (stage 1) to 0.878 (stage 2) to 0.955 (stage 3) with 285 of 1072 cases referred for manual review.
links.quote: The CLUES framework reduced manual review burden by 75% while maintaining high accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Entropy-based uncertainty quantification with staged few-shot retrieval prompting to triage cases for selective manual chart review
